summary: cfg() calls gstack_config_select, which re-runs gstack_state_root_select. Because doctor has already set GSTACK_STATE_ROOT (line 594), the re-run overwrites _gstack_sr_var with "GSTACK_STATE_ROOT". In --check mode, _dc_check_codex_cli calls cfg before _dc_check_state_root, so the state-root row credits the wrong source (a default root is reported as chosen by GSTACK_STATE_ROOT).
evidence: With HOME set to an empty temp dir and GSTACK_* unset, `bash bin/gstack-doctor --check` prints `PASS state-root …/.gstack durable=yes (selected by default; …)` on main and `PASS state-root …/.gstack durable=yes (selected by GSTACK_STATE_ROOT; …)` on this branch. Component order is `claude codex patch codex-cli … state-root` (bin/gstack-doctor-components.sh:7); _dc_check_codex_cli's first line is `cfg codex_reviews enabled`; bin/gstack-doctor-check.sh:393 prints `$_gstack_sr_var`.
